decisions.requestBaseline: Use the proven Set Factory TCDB request headers: User-Agent Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; VCS Set Factory research import), Accept text/html,application/xhtml+xml. Fail closed on any incomplete checklist.
decisions.series: Combine Series One #1-220 and Series Two #221-440 into one 440-card Base ProductSet. The two physical series are equal checklist size, so VCS gives them equal base pull weight regardless of historical production volume.
decisions.pack: VCS uses four cards per pack and 24 packs per box. Historical 1999 Bowman hobby packs contained 10 cards and boxes contained 24 packs.
decisions.baseOdds: All 440 Base cards are equally weighted. No prospect/rookie boost and no series boost.
decisions.trueRookies: Append RC only to the 148 Base card numbers returned by the TCDB rookie index. Prospect status alone never creates an RC label; parallels and inserts do not inherit RC labels.
decisions.cleanNames: Player contains only the clean subject name plus true RC where applicable. TCDB UER/ERR/COR/VAR, SN, AU, foil, series and request-card metadata stay out of Player.
decisions.parallels: International and Gold are each full 440-card parallel ProductSets verified card-by-card against Base. International is one per physical pack in both series and remains 1:1. Gold is SN99; equal-series weighting of 1:111 Series One and 1:59 Series Two yields about 1:77 combined VCS packs.
decisions.seriesOnlyInserts: Series-only insert families at 1:12 in their applicable physical series become 1:24 in the combined VCS product because Series One and Series Two receive equal 50/50 base weight.
decisions.autographs: Certified Autographs remain one source family but are split into Blue, Silver and Gold ProductSets solely to preserve their materially different real-world rarity. Each color combines its Series One and Series Two cards with equal-series weighted odds: Blue about 1:111, Silver about 1:335, Gold about 1:1356. No per-player rarity or invented variant odds.
decisions.boxChecklist: The two NNO Checklist / Certificate Request cards were inserted one per 24-pack box. They are represented as one 2-card ProductSet at 1:24; internal S1-NNO and S2-NNO keys preserve the two distinct physical cards without pretending NNO is unique.
decisions.excluded: Exclude the 6-card Pre-Production dealer promo set; it was promotional material, not a normal pack-issued chase set.
decisions.release: Keep unreleased until live source generation, dry-run/apply validation, team/rookie checks, images, pack art, pricing and pack-rarity smoke testing are complete.
